original_bad_branch: if d<0: add sqrt(-2F/d) as an exact zero-circle point
why_it_is_not_a_counterexample: The computed lambda is merely an approximate closure parameter, while exact least-period four has d=0. Its O(1e-74) closure/parameter error is amplified by a fictitious M of size O(1e37). The theorem assumes exact closure, and no true exceptional circle exists for N=4.
correction: Use the exact algebraic N4 classification d=0; in finite diagnostics do not classify tiny sign noise near that known boundary as a genuine star regime. The corrected independent controls separate |d|<1e-45 from d<-1e-45 and use ordinary finite M in the N4 boundary control.
